prompt: Toggling the sidebar or opening any menu makes the board stutter. All five columns seem to redraw even though no card changed.

truth.summary: selectCardsForColumn is one createSelector instance shared by five columns with a per-column status argument. Its single-entry cache is overwritten by each column in turn, so every store update recomputes and returns a new array for every column.

referenceAnswer.cause: All columns share one createSelector with a status argument; the one-entry cache thrashes between columns, so each store update returns a new cards array and re-renders every column.

decoyAnswers.cause: The openIssue callback is recreated on every render.

referenceFix.replace:
export const makeSelectCardsForColumn = () =>
  createSelector(
    [selectBoardIssues, (_state: RootState, status: IssueStatus) => status],
    (issues, status) => issues.filter((issue) => issue.status === status),
  )

const selectCards = useMemo(makeSelectCardsForColumn, [])
  const cards = useAppSelector((state) => selectCards(state, status))

genieEvidence.notes: react_get_renders shows each BoardColumn update with cause external-store, evidence inferred, name 'anonymous-external-store'. Genie cannot show the selector's cache misses or which argument thrashed it; the agent must read the selector to connect the two.
